audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Ziggs / Ziggs / Ziggs / Skill / Ziggs / Skill / Ziggs while whys[1] and whys[2] both describe Renekton winning those levels and whys[5] describes his Dominus spike winning the first-item row. The mirror (renekton__ziggs) settled rows 1 and 2 as Skill and rows 4 and 5 as Renekton.
audit.why: Levels 2-3 are a spacing question rather than a free win for either side — he must close to 300 for Ruthless Predator and 450 for Slice and Dice, but your Satchel Charge is 20s against his 16s W, so neither of you can act on demand. Level 6 and first item are his: Dominus gives bonus health and generates Fury on its own.
audit.corrected: phases[1]/[2].side + win[1]/[2] to Skill (8/10 -> 5/10), phases[4]/[5].side + win[4]/[5] to Renekton (8/10 -> 4/10, 5/10 -> 4/10), as matched pairs in one atomic group, with four why lines rewritten on each layer.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why claimed level 6 as your Mega Inferno Bomb spike and phases[5].why as your Blackfire Torch spike. Both are his rows.
audit.why: Dominus is 120/100/80s, gives bonus health, damages everything around him and feeds him Fury periodically — which re-arms the empowered 1.5s stun. Your ult does not contest a melee all-in; it buys map tempo, which is a different thing.
audit.corrected: Both why lines restated as his spikes, with the anti-heal requirement attached to the first-item row.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0].text writes 'Ruthless Predation' — the packet flagged it and it is genuinely wrong; the ability is Ruthless Predator. No cooldowns or stun durations appear anywhere, and dontsFull[0].d was filler.
audit.why: Ruthless Predator is 16/14/12/10/8s, stuns 0.75s, and stuns 1.5s while he is above 50 Fury — double the lockdown, which is exactly the difference between surviving on Satchel Charge and not. It is also an auto-attack reset, so the wind-up, not the cast, is the cue to step back. Slice and Dice is two 450-unit dashes on 16s, so a minefield slow does not stop the second half.
audit.corrected: Real name restored, 16s / 0.75s / 1.5s written into spikes[0].text and breakdown.cooldowns, the auto-reset tell into dontsFull[0].d, and the two-dash point into phases[2].why.

audit.why: Cull the Meek heals him on a 7s cooldown and more so above 50 Fury, so chip poke alone does not stick — report[8].t already ends 'Add anti-heal early into his sustain.'
audit.corrected: No edit to the item line; the requirement is now also stated on the first-item row where it decides the trade.

edits.before: W Satchel online — your disengage button. You can now take a greedy trade and blast yourself out of the answer.
edits.after: W Satchel online at 20s — your only escape. Ruthless Predator is 16s, so his answer returns before yours.

edits.before: Full kit: E minefield behind you makes you nearly unchaseable. Bounce Q off the wave so Renekton can't read the angle.
edits.after: Full kit, but Slice and Dice crosses 450 twice — the minefield slows him, it does not stop the second dash.

edits.before: Mega Inferno Bomb online — any chipped target or crashing wave is now your gold. Hold it for the sub-60% HP window.
edits.after: Dominus online: bonus health and Fury generated for free. Shove and roam — do not duel him through it.

edits.before: Blackfire Torch spike — your Q chunks become unhealable burn chip. Renekton now chooses between farm and HP every wave.
edits.after: His item spike lands on top of Dominus, and Cull the Meek heals him through your chip — buy anti-heal early.

edits.before: Level 2 Renekton gains Ruthless Predation and can W-stun into a favourable trade.
edits.after: Level 2 Ruthless Predator stuns for 0.75s, but he must first close to 300.

edits.before: Level 3 his full Slice-Dice-W combo with fury is a hard kill window on you.
edits.after: Level 3 his Slice and Dice combo lands only if you let him inside 450.

edits.before: At 6 your Mega Inferno Bomb and shove-and-roam pattern give you tempo control.
edits.after: At 6 Dominus adds bonus health and damage, so his all-in still beats yours.

edits.before: - Renekton Ruthless Predator (Stun): matchup-defining — Fury-empowered stun — never trade into a full rage bar. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W Satchel for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Renekton Ruthless Predator (Stun): matchup-defining — 16s at rank 1, a 0.75s stun that becomes 1.5s above 50 Fury. Never trade into a full rage bar. - Budget W Satchel (20s) for emergencies and the R for opportunities.

edits.before: Renekton burns Ruthless Predator (Stun) on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Renekton burns Ruthless Predator (Stun) on nothing — take the sixteen-second invitation.

edits.before: That is Renekton’s whole plan in one window — decline politely and watch it retire.
edits.after: Ruthless Predator resets his auto-attack — the wind-up is your cue, not the cast.

edits.before: This is Renekton's kill window: with 3 points he can Slice (E) in, Ruthless Predation (W) stun and Dice back out, and full fury lets him blow you up before you can W away.
edits.after: This is his kill window: with 3 points he Slices (E) in from 450, Ruthless Predator (W) stuns 0.75s — 1.5s past 50 Fury — and Dice takes him back out before your 20s Satchel returns.

notes: Chart rows 1, 2, 4 and 5 proposed as matched pairs in one atomic group, following the mirror. Genuine name defect fixed: 'Ruthless Predation' -> 'Ruthless Predator' in spikes[0].text (packet.defects was right on this one, unlike most suspectNames hits in this slice). Flag misfire honoured from the mirror: ziggs.json tags Satchel Charge percentHealth but Riot's text says only magic damage plus knockback, so nothing max-health was written. Left unasserted because the kit text does not say: whether the empowered 1.5s stun is reduced by tenacity or cleansable, and whether Satchel Charge's knockback can interrupt Slice and Dice mid-dash.
